note: 116: the strategist's parameter sweep (scripts/tune/agent_sweep.py, scripts/tune/README.md). Each parameter is an agent-spec key, its hand-set value (the strategist's default: `STRATEGIST` in crates/aic-sim/src/agents/mod.rs over `Weights::engine`; the script checks it plays the same as plain `strategist`) and the grid the search walks. 229 refreshed the hand values to r100's strategist (strategy=0, w.table=0, w.horizon=0, w.packet_keep=1, w.chips 4). Seeds come from the ledger in docs/experiments.md: give a later revision fresh ones with --sweep-seed and --confirm-seed.

params.says: an insight a seat holds, in heuristic points
an energy held (and, through plan_rates, the keep plan's price of energy)
a credit held, up to credit_cap
a card's worth: heuristic points per value-table credit (cards in hand, drafted, built)
income valued over the rounds left: this x its weight x the rounds
credits a seat holds beyond this are worth credit_idle (0.225) each
keep threshold: the share of a card's keep price charged against drafting it
the strategy weights: how far a strategy's multipliers reach from 1 (0: every multiplier 1); the strategist plays strategy=0 since 222, so check it still moves play before reading it)
